messages:
Priya (CS): Quick weekly health snapshot for MapleTech — short version
Priya (CS): Usage +12% w/w, spend +8% m/m, active routes increasing (chat heavy)
Priya (CS): p95/p99 by route + model (streaming vs non-stream):
Priya (CS): • chat.v1 / redwood-2b: streaming p95 180ms p99 350ms; non-stream p95 420ms p99 1.1s
Priya (CS): • summarize.v1 / redwood-7b: streaming p95 240ms p99 620ms; non-stream p95 760ms p99 1.6s
Priya (CS): • embed.v1 / embed-1: streaming p95 90ms p99 160ms; non-stream p95 210ms p99 480ms
Priya (CS): Overall error rate 0.11% (noticed a spike to 0.8% at ~03:22 UTC last night)
Priya (CS): Main risks: non-stream latency tail on chat.v1 + rising monthly spend if usage keeps climbing
Noah (Acct): Thanks — renewal touchpoint in ~3 weeks, want to show improvement. ETA on fix?
Jon (SRE): I see kernel scheduling jitter affecting non-stream paths for chat.v1. Starting investigation.
Jon (SRE): Quick repro note: `ab -n 1000 -c 10 https://api.redwood/chat.v1` reproduced ~1.2s tail on pool-3
Aisha (SE): For MapleTech sessions, streaming helps a lot for long-turn conversations — I'll draft a one-pager with cost tradeoffs
Priya (CS): Action items:
Priya (CS): • Jon — investigate non-stream kernel/jitter, report by EOD
Priya (CS): • Aisha — share one-pager + cost delta for streaming vs non-stream by EOD
Priya (CS): • Noah — prep renewal talking points highlighting latency plan
Jon (SRE): EOD update: found NVLink contention on gpu-pool-3 during bursty traffic. Temporary mitigation: route non-stream to pool-2 now
alerts-bot: Incident alert — latency spike detected for chat.v1 non-stream at 03:22 UTC; routing fallback applied automatically
Milo (Infra): Applied routing override for MapleTech non-stream to gpu-pool-2, monitoring metrics now
Aisha (SE): Shared one-pager here: https://drive.redwood/Maple_streaming_onepager — includes expected p99 gains + cost delta
Priya (CS): Cost estimate: streaming reduces chat.v1 p99 by ~40% but increases token billing by ~6%; net spend +3-4% on current workload
Noah (Acct): OK — will present tradeoffs to customer. Any user-facing complaints logged?
Priya (CS): No complaints yet; outreach scheduled tomorrow 10:00am PT to proactively brief them
Jon (SRE): Full fix requires kernel patch; timeline ~72 hours for rollout to all affected nodes (post-testing)
Priya (CS): Marking renewal risk as moderate until kernel patch is rolled — will update scorecard after patch verification
Noah (Acct): Good. If remediation slips, we may offer a small credit — I'll coordinate with finance if needed
Priya (CS): Thanks everyone — next check-in Friday same thread :thumbsup:
